author: Tyler, 1959

note.en: A 25 cm flounder with three white-centred eye-spots, living on soft shelf bottoms at 70 to 260 m; known here only from Bussing & López's guide.
note.es: Un lenguado de 25 cm con tres ocelos de centro blanco, que vive en fondos blandos de plataforma entre 70 y 260 m; conocido aquí solo por la guía de Bussing y López.

evidence: Added: not in the original species list
Listed for Costa Rica's Caribbean coast by Bussing & López (2010), whose guide is based on University of Costa Rica museum specimens

sources.t: Bussing & López 2010, Peces costeros del Caribe de Centroamérica meridional, Rev. Biol. Trop. 58 (Suppl. 2): 190-193 (Paralichthyidae)
